name: Chiura Marin
source:
Grade: Junior high school 2nd grader.
Room: Megae Dorm, Room 201.
Characteristics: Since she is an immigrant, Marin is not accustomed to Japanese customs. She is carefree and does things at her own pace. Her hobby is napping, so she tends to fall asleep everywhere. Marin is popular at the dorm due to her stories about living abroad.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
